note: The cowboy ribeye's marbled char-and-fat richness obliterates the crab cake's delicate sweet crab in a crisp crust: the marbled char overshadows the delicate crab cake, and the rendered fat crowds out the sweet shellfish plate. Avoid; the cut is too bold for the delicate starter. Stand the crab cake on its own course -- pair the crab cake with Joseph Mellot Sancerre, Domaine de Berthiers Pouilly-Fumé, or Tanqueray Gin -- and pour Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon, Silver Oak Cabernet Sauvignon, or Shafer Hillside Select for the cowboy ribeye.
